_comment: Client reads of a clinical table that carry no clinical content, and so need no access-log
row. Each entry is a judgement that the columns selected are metadata -- an id, a date, a
count -- rather than the record itself. Add one in the same change set that makes it true,
and state which columns and why. 'It only reads a couple of fields' is not a reason; naming
This is not a licence to widen the select later: an entry covers the read as it stands, and
the reviewer of the next change to that file is the one who has to agree it still holds.

src/hooks/useCareLevelReview.ts.reason: Selects resident_id and assessed_at only, filtered to finalized assessments, to answer whether a resident's billed level of care has been reassessed. A date and an id: it says an assessment happened, never what it found. Widening this select past those two columns makes it a chart read and it must move to a logged RPC.
